findings.description: The bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, so uploaded reports are not enforced to be encrypted at rest. Sensitive archive data could be stored without S3-managed or KMS encryption.
The private ACL does not enforce encryption at rest. Objects uploaded without an explicit encryption header can remain unencrypted.
Versioning and access logging do not enable server-side encryption. Model artifacts can be uploaded and retained unencrypted at rest.
This bucket does not configure default server-side encryption, allowing runbook objects to be stored without encryption at rest.
